spanish: Edifiquen a ustedes ciudades a su niño, y cercados a su rebaño, y lo saliente desde su boca harán.

findings.issue: H2945 is a collective (little ones) in the masculine singular construct with a 2mp suffix; 'niño' narrows that group to one male child.

notes: Other tokens match: qal 2mp build, cities, fences, flock, and do what goes out from the mouth.
